spec: §15 suite C; §4.6 qregion with @image: cell i = bits [iW,(i+1)W) of the little-endian image; qload/qxor/qunload
derivation: Data `bytes` is hex dead: byte 0 = 0xde is cell 0 and byte 1 = 0xad is cell 1. image XORs the loaded cell into t and unloads, restoring the region. t = 0x35: with p=0, 0x35 xor 0xde = 0xeb = 235.
